sections.Profile:
"Carnival," released by Marvel Manufacturing Company in February 1947, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine from the company's last year before it added flippers to its games.

- Manufacturer: Marvel Manufacturing Company
- Years made: 1947
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Original Theme
